Name: Sharezer, Son of Sennacherib
Summary: Sharezer, with his brother Adrammelech, slew their father Sennacherib as he worshipped in the house of Nisroch, and escaped to Armenia.
RelatedPeople: Sennacherib, King of Assyria; Adrammelech, Son of Sennacherib
LifeLesson: An empire built on terror ends in terror at home.
